content: If B us Mirroring is enabled globally (configuration parameter LinIfBusMirroringSupported ) and has been activated with a call to LinIf_EnableBusMirroring() for a LIN channel, the LIN Interface shall call Mirror_ReportLinFrame() each time LinIf_TxConfirmation is called on that channel , with status code LIN_ T X_OK and a pointer to the transmitted data .
